base:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a Windows desktop pet.
Create a beautiful charming PURE WHITE baby kitten, fluffy white fur, large round powder blue eyes, pink inner ears and tiny pink nose, short round legs, soft rounded tail. Polished 2D hand-painted anime game pet, delicate cool light-gray edge outlines so white fur remains visible on any background, soft white fur shading, adorable expressive face. NO clothing, NO collar, NO markings or colored fur.
EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal square cells in a regular grid, consistent character design, whole kitten visible inside every cell, generous transparent margins, no text, no dividers, no scene background. Same camera and kitten scale across cells. True transparent alpha.
Reading order poses:
row 1: (1) sitting upright facing viewer, eyes open, tail curving right (2) same sitting, eyes softly closed blinking (3) sitting grooming with left forepaw raised to mouth and pink tongue out (4) same grooming, paw held higher, tongue touches paw.
row 2: (5) playing, crouched with front paws forward ready to pounce, eyes excited (6) playful pounce in air reaching forepaws forward (7) lying on back, pink paw pads visible, rolling with head tilted left (8) same belly-up roll, head tilted right, feet in different position.
row 3: (9) deep cat stretch, forelegs extended along ground, bottom raised and eyes closed (10) standing relaxed side three-quarter view, tail raised (11) curled up asleep side view, eyes CLOSED with head resting on paws, compact cute curl (12) sleeping on side with paws relaxed, eyes CLOSED, no symbols.
row 4: (13) crouching head lowered eating, tongue visible and NO bowl (14) same eating, slightly raised head, eyes happy squint (15) sitting lifting forepaw to bat at a fish, eyes focused upward (16) sitting with both forepaws held up happily, tiny open smiling mouth.
No accessories, no food props, no fish props. Each pose centered at same floor baseline within its cell. High resolution detailed clean isolated edges.
outfits: a soft pastel ROSE PINK hoodless knit sweater vest with a tiny ivory heart on the back, short sleeves, pink ribbed hem. No hat.
a powder SKY BLUE sailor pet shirt with white striped navy-style collar and tiny blue ribbon on the chest. No hat.
a warm SUNFLOWER YELLOW hoodless cozy short-sleeve pet sweater with little cream ribbed edging. No hat.
extra:
Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image: the exact pure white blue-eyed kitten character in the reference atlas. Create a NEW supplemental animation sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, twelve equal square cells, same lovely fluffy white kitten, same painting and soft fine gray outlines, white fur everywhere, pink ears and nose, blue eyes, no clothing, no collar. True transparent alpha. Full kitten with clear margins inside every cell, no floor or symbols or text, no dividers.
Keep body size and floor baseline registered. This is for real animations so variations in paired cells must be small and clear.
Row 1: cell1 sitting torso facing front, head turned to look to viewer LEFT; cell2 same body, head turned to look to viewer RIGHT; cell3 seated cat YAWNING with eyes firmly CLOSED and mouth open wide in a natural oval, tiny pink tongue, sleepy; cell4 same seated cat finishing yawn with eyes closed and mouth slightly open.
Row 2: cell5 front three-quarter view in low relaxed crouch doing kneading, LEFT forepaw extended forward pressing down, right forepaw bent up; cell6 exact same kneading posture, RIGHT forepaw pressing down, left forepaw bent up; cell7 sitting facing front, SAME HEAD and body as neutral source, fluffy tail curved outward to viewer right; cell8 same sitting body registered and still, tail tip now swished upward inward behind the body.
Row 3: cell9 sitting scratching behind its ear with one hind paw; cell10 sitting with ears perked and head gently tilted; cell11 curled up asleep with eyes CLOSED and nose nestled into paws; cell12 still LYING FLAT HALF-CURLED ASLEEP, eyes CLOSED, stretches front paws out forward while head stays on ground. No standing in last row last two cells.
Generous padding, identical camera and character identity. No accessories no props.
fishing:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation keyframes for a desktop pet cat catching fish by itself. Reference is the same PURE WHITE fluffy baby kitten, blue eyes, pink nose and ears, fine gray outlines and soft polished 2D anime game illustration. No clothing. NEW sheet EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight equal square cells with clear transparent margins, same camera, same kitten proportions and stable ground baseline. Side three-quarter view FACING VIEWER LEFT for all eight cells. Important: kitten looks DOWN at a water puddle near the bottom-left of the cell, not up in the air. No puddle drawn, no floor or scenery (game draws water separately). Fully isolated on true transparent alpha.
Row1 cell1: kitten crouches low on all fours staring DOWN toward bottom-left, hindquarters slightly raised, tail still.
cell2: same low crouch, lifts nearer front paw bent ready to strike down, gaze locked DOWN to lower-left.
cell3: kitten leans FORWARD and DOWN, nearer front paw thrust DOWN and LEFT to floor level, head low and focused.
cell4: full committed forward pounce with both forepaws together stretched DOWN and LEFT to floor level, body elongated, hindlegs braced, tail pointing back.
Row2 cell1: kitten sits back proud, visibly holds ONE TINY BLUE FISH crosswise in its mouth, eyes happily squinting, fish is toy-like and cute, no gore.
cell2: same proud successful kitten sitting with the same tiny blue fish in its mouth, tail raised and happy.
cell3: unsuccessful kitten sits back pulling one wet paw up to chest, ears slightly sideways, surprised round eyes and small 'o' mouth, three tiny clean water drops near the raised paw.
cell4: kitten sits licking its wet raised front paw with small pink tongue, gentle embarrassed eyes.
The gesture must clearly be FISHING DOWN INTO WATER, not waving upright. No water background, no text no symbols no grid lines. Same white kitten from reference.
wardrobeVariants: Each supplemental atlas was edited using the naked pose sheet as edit target and the corresponding outfit atlas as clothing reference. Only clothing changed.
